details: Negotiations between the US and Iran in Switzerland collapsed over the weekend, with Iran's delegation walking out due to fresh threats from President Donald Trump regarding Lebanon and the Strait of Hormuz. This breakdown has intensified fears of an oil shock and a potential risk-off environment for markets, as shipping has reportedly stalled in the Strait of Hormuz after Iran declared the key waterway shut.
title: US-Iran Talks Fracture in Switzerland, Raising Oil and Market Fears.

details: Israeli military actions in southern Lebanon have escalated, with reports of attacks continuing despite an agreed partial ceasefire. This escalation is seen by analysts as threatening to undermine broader agreements between Tehran and Washington. In Gaza, Israeli strikes have continued almost daily, killing several people, including an Al Jazeera cameraman, despite an October ceasefire.
title: Israeli Escalation in Lebanon Threatens Iran-US Agreement; Gaza Attacks Continue.

details: Ukraine carried out a significant wave of drone attacks on Russia overnight, with a majority targeting Moscow and successfully striking the city's main oil refinery. This represents one of the largest attacks on the Russian capital since the start of the war. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy justified these attacks as a response to intense Russian bombing of Ukrainian cities.
title: Ukraine Launches Major Drone Attacks on Moscow Oil Refinery.
